sentences.l2: 很早以前，人们用风吹动风车来工作。
sentences.l1: Long ago, people used the wind to blow windmills to work.

sentences.l2: 后来，人们发明了新的技术。
电可以让灯亮，让电视工作。
sentences.l1: Electricity can make lights bright and make televisions work.
The sun can also generate electricity.

sentences.l2: 人们用太阳能电池板吸收阳光。
sentences.l1: People use solar panels to absorb sunlight.

sentences.l2: 这些东西不会污染空气。
sentences.l1: These things do not pollute the air.
Before, there were no such technologies.

sentences.l2: 创新带来新的发电方法。
sentences.l1: Innovation brings new methods of generating electricity.
Clean energy is good for the Earth.

sentences.l2: 用清洁能源，空气会更干净。
sentences.l1: Using clean energy, the air will be cleaner.
The water will also be cleaner.
